notes: WooCommerce-based bus sales site. Successfully extracts 30 listings with titles (100% rate), but price, image src, and link href attributes require JavaScript rendering. Page uses dynamic content loading. Titles contain year, make, model, and stock ID (e.g., '2026 Thomas C2 30+1 WC – 4700'). Full scraping requires Playwright/Selenium for JS execution. Standard WooCommerce pagination is present.
